name: FX-6 (Begamor)
description: FX-6 was a waiter droid at the presidential manor on Begamor during the High Republic Era. During Sean's mission to Begamor, FX-6 detected allergens in the kaadu ribs the chef Bellon had prepared. Out of anger, Bellon attacked the droid, but FX-6 was able to stun him.
